author: GameSpot
description:
The future of PC gaming hardware appears to be in an interesting position at the moment, with rumors swirling that NVIDIA reviving production of its 3060 graphics card which originally shipped in 2021. Kurt and Lucy talk it over in this week's episode of Kurt & Lucy Gotcha Covered.

Email your letters to gotchacovered@gamespot.com

Watch the full Kurt & Lucy Gotcha Covered Episode: https://youtu.be/KR7qaAplTXE
title: Bringing Back RTX 3060s Isn't Such A Bad Idea
